name: Qobuz
author: Javier Herrera
description: Qobuz for Omarchy: a bar widget with a full-screen player, driven by the qbzd headless daemon.

barWidget.description: Now playing, transport and the queue in the bar; the full library opens as an app.

schema.label: qbzd host
schema.description: Host and port of the qbzd control API. Point it at another machine to control a remote player.

schema.label: Show the track in the bar
schema.description: Off leaves just the play/pause glyph. A vertical bar always collapses to the glyph.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is playing
schema.description: Collapse the widget out of the bar while qbzd is stopped.
